Entities / Characters / Perrin Black Jaw

Perrin Black-Jaw

Three feet tall. Ten-year-old lean fancy-rat Rattkin: black head, white body, long pink tail, olive-drab hooded cloak, cream shirt, bodhran drum at hip, oversized longsword that looks too big for him. Shortest person in the party by a significant margin; compensates with volume, charm, and nerve.

Used Minor Illusion to conceal the doorway in the Saltwright hold during the ambush.

Foundation

Class: Bard 3 (College of Lore) / Warlock 1 (Pact of the Blade) | Background: Custom | Player: Kaden

Species: Rattkin (fancy rat) | Languages: Common, Dwarvish, Gnomish

Mortis: “The Small” — disadvantage on Strength checks/saves; +2 Charisma. His frame makes him unsuitable for hard ship labor, so he leads by reading currents, people, exits, and leverage.

Core drive: Vengeance against the thing that destroyed the Vestra. He also genuinely misses fishing, wants to support his family, and wants to become an elder of the Tangle who teaches young Rattkin how to move through the Dry without getting killed.

What he does not see: The chase has become the point. The version of him that survives it may not fit the Run hierarchy anymore, and he may put his family in the path of vengeance to get there.

Beliefs And Limits

  • Loyal to his Run specifically, not Rattkin broadly. Proud, not supremacist.
  • Will not traffic people. Manipulation, bribery, and blackmail remain available tools.
  • Does not mistreat people who cannot fight back. He also stops paying attention to them.
  • Sees people as useful or not useful, and accepts this about himself.

Current Pressure

His family knows he is alive. They do not know the full scale of the Vestra‘s loss or that the ship is gone. He has gone quiet on them and knows it.

The Vestra was built and captained by Nona Black-Jaw’s late husband, Perrin’s grandfather. Losing it is not just a financial blow; it was the last thing his grandfather left.

Recently, something large and otherworldly spoke to him from the abyss. He was not a believer before. Now a patron-level power has decided he matters, and he does not know what that means.

The timeline source says the Leviathan destroyed the Vestra and that Perrin believes his old cloak saved him. It was actually Auralis. Perrin forged a warlock pact in the wreck without knowing it. The Cloak of the Manta Ray is no longer with him.

What He Carries

  • Cloak of Protection (attuned) — current; the Manta Ray cloak is gone
  • Mira’s Blade
  • Nona’s sending stone
  • Longsword, bodhran drum, Clyde’s Bestiary of Oceanic Creatures
  • Guilt about crew members he thinks died

Party

Jean-Claude Tabarnack, Delmar Fisk, Crissdalynn Khinriss. Cobb is an old contact met at La Vasca on the Calveno arrival.

Unresolved Threads

  • A surviving Vestra crew member could walk through a door; relief would arrive wrapped in guilt.
  • Family does not know about the ship.
  • Perrin does not know what destroyed the Vestra, only that it was massive and came from deep below.
  • Dravosi bounties on Rattkin are a background pressure: real, rarely enforced, always present.

Combat Notes

Strengths: Reading people and situations, social pressure, charm, bribery, escape routes, Bard/Warlock magic.

Weaknesses: Prey response when genuinely scared; physical weakness from Mortis; limited trust for dry-landers; Crissdalynn‘s avian shape sits directly against his instinctive fear response.

Crisis response: Finds the nearest exit first. Not necessarily to run, but to know it is there.

Session Events

  • Session 01 — Laid Minor Illusion over the hold doorway; emerged from a deck gap at a second angle during the breach; resisted Grung toxin gas.
  • Session 02 — Received Beaumont‘s message: Nona Black-Jaw is searching for him; Anzolo may already be at sea. Drew his longsword to kill Ket before Crissdalynn intervened; cast Tasha’s Hideous Laughter to drop Ket safely. Received Mira’s Blade from the cargo. Named himself as a Black-Jaw to the assembled crew. See Nona and Anzolo.
  • Session 03 — Experienced the abyss vision on watch: worked stone floor, bioluminescent entities, inhabited a 60-ft creature’s body, witnessed something longer than two ships below, heard “Grow.” Gave bardic inspiration to all three party members and drummed through the whip shark fight. Navigated the alternate approach into Calveno. Renamed ship to Uncertainty on approach. Met Nona in Le Paludi — told her about the Vestra, attacks called off, promised a favor without conditions. Received Nona’s sending stone. Spotted the bioluminescent whale on day 2 at sea and recognized it. Met Master Kyzil; emerged from a barrel to shake his finger.
  • Session 04 — Led the party to the Ponte Bassa as their Calveno base — chose it to avoid bringing two avian predators into a Rattkin establishment. Won the boots of flying roll but passed them to Delmar — doesn’t wear shoes (“I have little rat feet and I need to feel the ground”). Supported the Kyzil spar: healing word on Delmar (7 HP) and Crissdalynn (8 HP), bardic inspiration saved Crissdalynn’s grapple (Downburst save 15+d6=20), attempted cutting words on Kyzil’s attack vs himself (insufficient). Drummed from behind cover; Kyzil identified the drum as a tactical threat. Went invisible in the sewers alongside Jean-Claude, used Rattkin keen senses (5ft detection) and nose to track black powder scent. Swam underwater to scout the Grung boat — returned with intel on 3 Grung and 8 barrels. Sent urgent sending stone message to Nona about the operation. Shared a silent knowing look with Delmar during the confession — hinted at his own undisclosed loss without revealing it.
